declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties reached the settlement through an exchange of proposals and counterproposals. The final terms provide a $35,000,000 class fund, automatic payments to identified class members, and $5,000,000 in attorneys’ fees and expenses, subject to the Court’s independent review. Brightline has not agreed to clear sailing, and any fee amount not awarded will benefit the class.
